mapper.select: SELECT STAFF_SQ, STAFF_NM, DEPT_NM, POSITION_NM, STATUS_CD FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M ORDER BY STAFF_NM
SELECT EMPLY_ID, EMPLY_NM FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD = '2' AND IFNULL(DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY EMPLY_NM

SELECT T.TEAM_SQ, T.TEAM_NM, T.FIELD_NM, T.PLACE, T.USE_YN , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R M WHERE M.TARGET_CD = 'LAB_TEAM' AND M.TARGET_SQ = T.TEAM_SQ) AS MEMO_CNT , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(A.STEP_NM, ' ', IFNULL(E.EMPLY_NM, A.EMPLY_ID)) ORDER BY A.STEP_NO SEPARATOR ' → ') FROM TB_EEP_LAB_APPR_R A LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E ON E.EMPLY_ID = A.EMPLY_ID WHERE A.TEAM_SQ = T.TEAM_SQ) AS APPR_LINE , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_LAB_RESEARCHER_M R WHERE R.TEAM_SQ = T.TEAM_SQ AND (R.END_DT IS NULL OR R.END_DT >= CURDATE())) AS RSCH_CNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_LAB_PROJECT_M P WHERE P.TEAM_SQ = T.TEAM_SQ) AS PRJ_CNT FROM TB_EEP_LAB_TEAM_M T WHERE T.TEAM_SQ = #{TEAM_SQ} ORDER BY T.USE_YN DESC, T.TEAM_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_LAB_TEAM_M (TEAM_NM, FIELD_NM, PLACE, USE_YN, MEMO, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) VALUES (#{TEAM_NM}, NULLIF(#{FIELD_NM}, ''), NULLIF(#{PLACE}, ''), #{USE_YN}, NULLIF(#{MEMO}, ''), #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT A.STEP_NO, A.STEP_NM, A.EMPLY_ID, E.EMPLY_NM , (SELECT S.SIGN_IMG FROM TB_EEP_LAB_SIGN_H S WHERE S.EMPLY_ID = A.EMPLY_ID ORDER BY S.SIGN_SQ DESC LIMIT 1) AS SIGN_IMG FROM TB_EEP_LAB_APPR_R A LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E ON E.EMPLY_ID = A.EMPLY_ID WHERE A.TEAM_SQ = #{TEAM_SQ} ORDER BY A.STEP_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_LAB_APPR_R (TEAM_SQ, STEP_NO, STEP_NM, EMPLY_ID) VALUES (#{TEAM_SQ}, #{STEP_NO}, #{STEP_NM}, #{EMPLY_ID})
mapper.select: SELECT S.STAFF_NM, S.EMPLY_ID FROM TB_EEP_LAB_RESEARCHER_M R JOIN TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M S ON S.STAFF_SQ = R.STAFF_SQ WHERE R.TEAM_SQ = #{TEAM_SQ} AND R.ROLE_CD = 'HEAD' AND R.START_DT <= DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)) AND (R.END_DT IS NULL OR R.END_DT >= DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR))) ORDER BY R.START_DT DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SIGN_SQ, SIGN_IMG FROM TB_EEP_LAB_SIGN_H WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{emplyId} ORDER BY SIGN_SQ DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_LAB_SIGN_H (EMPLY_ID, SIGN_IMG, REG_DT) VALUES (#{EMPLY_ID}, #{SIGN_IMG}, DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR))
mapper.select: SELECT R.RSCH_SQ, R.TEAM_SQ, R.STAFF_SQ, S.STAFF_NM, S.DEPT_NM, R.ROLE_CD , DATE_FORMAT(R.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DT, DATE_FORMAT(R.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS END_DT FROM TB_EEP_LAB_RESEARCHER_M R JOIN TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M S ON S.STAFF_SQ = R.STAFF_SQ WHERE R.TEAM_SQ = #{TEAM_SQ} ORDER BY R.END_DT IS NULL DESC, R.END_DT DESC, R.ROLE_CD, S.STAFF_NM

SELECT S.STAFF_NM, R.ROLE_CD, MAX(S.COMPANY_EMAIL) AS COMPANY_EMAIL, MAX(S.EMAIL) AS EMAIL FROM TB_EEP_LAB_RESEARCHER_M R JOIN TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M S ON S.STAFF_SQ = R.STAFF_SQ WHERE R.TEAM_SQ = #{teamSq} AND R.START_DT <= LAST_DAY(CONCAT(#{ym}, '-01')) AND (R.END_DT IS NULL OR R.END_DT >= CONCAT(#{ym}, '-01')) GROUP BY R.STAFF_SQ, S.STAFF_NM, R.ROLE_CD ORDER BY R.ROLE_CD, S.STAFF_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_LAB_RESEARCHER_M (TEAM_SQ, STAFF_SQ, ROLE_CD, START_DT, END_DT, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) VALUES (#{TEAM_SQ}, #{STAFF_SQ}, #{ROLE_CD}, #{START_DT}, NULLIF(#{END_DT}, ''), #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT P.PRJ_SQ, P.TEAM_SQ, T.TEAM_NM, P.PRJ_NM, P.PLACE , DATE_FORMAT(P.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DT, DATE_FORMAT(P.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS END_DT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M J WHERE J.PRJ_SQ = P.PRJ_SQ) AS JRN_CNT , (SELECT J.YM FROM TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M J WHERE J.PRJ_SQ = P.PRJ_SQ ORDER BY J.YM DESC LIMIT 1) AS LAST_YM , (SELECT J.STATUS_CD FROM TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M J WHERE J.PRJ_SQ = P.PRJ_SQ ORDER BY J.YM DESC LIMIT 1) AS LAST_STATUS FROM TB_EEP_LAB_PROJECT_M P LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_LAB_TEAM_M T ON T.TEAM_SQ = P.TEAM_SQ ORDER BY P.END_DT DESC, P.PRJ_SQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_LAB_PROJECT_M (TEAM_SQ, PRJ_NM, START_DT, END_DT, PLACE, DRIVE_FOLDER_ID, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) VALUES (#{TEAM_SQ}, #{PRJ_NM}, #{START_DT}, #{END_DT}, #{PLACE}, #{DRIVE_FOLDER_ID}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT P.PRJ_SQ, P.TEAM_SQ, T.TEAM_NM, P.PRJ_NM, P.PLACE, P.DRIVE_FOLDER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(P.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DT, DATE_FORMAT(P.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS END_DT FROM TB_EEP_LAB_PROJECT_M P LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_LAB_TEAM_M T ON T.TEAM_SQ = P.TEAM_SQ WHERE P.PRJ_SQ = #{PRJ_SQ}

SELECT J.JRN_SQ, J.PRJ_SQ, J.YM, J.STATUS_CD, J.WRITER_NM, J.PDF_LINK, J.UPLOAD_ERR, J.ORIGIN_LINK, J.ATTACH_NM , (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(H.REG_DT), '%Y-%m-%d') FROM TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_H H WHERE H.JRN_SQ = J.JRN_SQ AND H.ACTION_CD IN ('CREATE', 'SUBMIT')) AS WRITE_DT FROM TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M J WHERE J.PRJ_SQ = #{PRJ_SQ} ORDER BY J.YM DESC

SELECT J.JRN_SQ, J.PRJ_SQ, P.TEAM_SQ, J.YM, J.CONTENT, J.STATUS_CD, J.CUR_STEP, J.WRITER_NM, J.SNAP_MEMBERS, J.PDF_FILE_ID, J.PDF_LINK, J.UPLOAD_ERR, J.ORIGIN_LINK, J.ATTACH_NM , DATE_FORMAT(J.MAIL_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS MAIL_DT , COALESCE(J.SNAP_PRJ_NM, P.PRJ_NM) AS PRJ_NM, COALESCE(J.SNAP_PLACE, P.PLACE) AS PLACE , COALESCE(J.SNAP_PERIOD, CONCAT(P.START_DT, ' ~ ', P.END_DT)) AS PERIOD , P.DRIVE_FOLDER_ID FROM TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M J JOIN TB_EEP_LAB_PROJECT_M P ON P.PRJ_SQ = J.PRJ_SQ WHERE J.JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ}
SELECT H.ACTION_CD, H.STATUS_CD, H.ACTOR_ID, H.ACTOR_NM, H.NOTE, DATE_FORMAT(H.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DT FROM TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_H H WHERE H.JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ} ORDER BY H.HIS_SQ

SELECT J.JRN_SQ, J.YM, IFNULL(J.SNAP_PRJ_NM, P.PRJ_NM) AS PRJ_NM, J.WRITER_NM, S.STEP_NM FROM TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M J JOIN TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_STEP S ON S.JRN_SQ = J.JRN_SQ AND S.STEP_NO = J.CUR_STEP LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_LAB_PROJECT_M P ON P.PRJ_SQ = J.PRJ_SQ WHERE J.STATUS_CD = 'SUBMITTED' AND S.EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} ORDER BY J.YM, J.JRN_SQ

SELECT T.STEP_NO, T.STEP_NM, T.EMPLY_ID, E.EMPLY_NM, T.DONE_NM, DATE_FORMAT(T.DONE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS DONE_DT , S.SIGN_IMG FROM TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_STEP T LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E ON E.EMPLY_ID = T.EMPLY_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_LAB_SIGN_H S ON S.SIGN_SQ = T.SIGN_SQ WHERE T.JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ} ORDER BY T.STEP_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_STEP (JRN_SQ, STEP_NO, STEP_NM, EMPLY_ID) SELECT #{JRN_SQ}, STEP_NO, STEP_NM, EMPLY_ID FROM TB_EEP_LAB_APPR_R WHERE TEAM_SQ = #{TEAM_SQ}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_STEP SET DONE_NM = #{ACTOR_NM}, DONE_DT = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR), SIGN_SQ = #{SIGN_SQ} WHERE JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ} AND STEP_NO = #{STEP_NO} AND DONE_DT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M (PRJ_SQ, YM, CONTENT, STATUS_CD, WRITER_EMPLY_ID, WRITER_NM) VALUES (#{PRJ_SQ}, #{YM}, #{CONTENT}, 'DRAFT', #{ACTOR_ID}, #{ACTOR_NM})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M SET CONTENT = #{CONTENT} WHERE JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ} AND STATUS_CD = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M J JOIN TB_EEP_LAB_PROJECT_M P ON P.PRJ_SQ = J.PRJ_SQ SET J.STATUS_CD = 'SUBMITTED', J.CUR_STEP = 1, J.SNAP_PRJ_NM = P.PRJ_NM, J.SNAP_PLACE = P.PLACE, J.SNAP_PERIOD = CONCAT(P.START_DT, ' ~ ', P.END_DT), J.SNAP_MEMBERS = #{MEMBERS} WHERE J.JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ} AND J.STATUS_CD = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M SET STATUS_CD = #{TO}, CUR_STEP = #{TO_STEP,jdbcType=INTEGER} WHERE JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ} AND STATUS_CD = 'SUBMITTED' AND CUR_STEP = #{FROM_STEP}
UPDATE TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M SET STATUS_CD = #{TO}, CUR_STEP = NULL , SNAP_PRJ_NM = NULL, SNAP_PLACE = NULL, SNAP_PERIOD = NULL, SNAP_MEMBERS = NULL WHERE JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ} AND STATUS_CD = #{FROM}
UPDATE TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M SET PDF_FILE_ID = #{PDF_FILE_ID}, PDF_LINK = #{PDF_LINK}, UPLOAD_ERR = NULL WHERE JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ}
UPDATE TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M SET UPLOAD_ERR = #{UPLOAD_ERR} WHERE JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ}
UPDATE TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M SET MAIL_DT = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR) WHERE JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_H (JRN_SQ, ACTION_CD, STATUS_CD, ACTOR_ID, ACTOR_NM, NOTE, SIGN_SQ, REG_DT) VALUES (#{JRN_SQ}, #{ACTION_CD}, #{STATUS_CD}, #{ACTOR_ID}, #{ACTOR_NM}, NULLIF(#{NOTE}, ''), #{SIGN_SQ}, DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR))
